mapper.sql: FROM material_item m JOIN material_category c ON c.id=m.category_id LEFT JOIN material_category p ON p.id=c.parent_id

where.if: AND (m.name ILIKE #{keywordPattern} ESCAPE '\' OR m.material_code ILIKE #{keywordPattern} ESCAPE '\')
AND m.category_id IN (SELECT id FROM material_category WHERE id=#{q.categoryId} OR parent_id=#{q.categoryId})

mapper.select: SELECT m.*, COALESCE(p.name || ' / ' || c.name,c.name) AS category_path ORDER BY m.created_at ASCDESC, m.id ASCDESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{pageOffset}
SELECT m.*, COALESCE(p.name || ' / ' || c.name,c.name) AS category_path WHERE m.id=#{id}
